content:
anya: Short follow-up on the attr-handling RFC: gateway eviction vs tenant partitioning. quick takes?

mike: Eviction = lower cost & simpler. Partitioning = best fidelity but ops-heavy.

tariq: Billing incident reminder: billing.customer_id got evicted once and billing queries returned unknown for hours. we need a plan for hot tenants.

lucy: Noisy tenants with many ephemeral keys cause downstream query spikes. containment matters.

anya: Proposed hybrid: pin a tiny required attr set at gateway, slim others, and fanout full events for detected noisy tenants for a window.

mike: Detection: 5m sliding unique-attr-growth + TPS threshold, cooldown to avoid flapping. write-full to tenant stream + slim to main stream.

tariq: Add safelist for enterprise customers that always get full fidelity; cap concurrent dedicated streams (eg 30).

lucy: Add soft-flag when pinned attrs missing instead of dropping traces so we can debug without losing data.

anya: Action: mike+tariq run a 3-day spike to prototype pinned-attr enforcement + fanout detector; lucy will prepare attribution evals. ingest-bot: create spike task.

ingest-bot: spike created by @anya -> PHAB-OBS-900 (https://phab.redwood/OBS-900).

mike: ack, will post results here. :thumbsup:
